development area: Knowledge of digital data inventories and metadata-driven discovery
description: Knowledge of how to search, interpret, and assess digital catalogues, metadata repositories, and data asset inventories to determine whether existing datasets can satisfy user needs.
historic work: Key Activities - Coordinates and organizes the retrieval, editing, validation, marketing and dissemination of data.
change to work: This activity will broaden to include pre-operational diagnostic work before retrieval and dissemination begin. Coordination will increasingly start with determining whether an identified need can be met through reuse of existing data assets, whether digital processes are available, and whether the request is operationally feasible and sustainable. The activity becomes less purely execution-focused and more intake-, triage-, and assessment-oriented.
justification: The current activity emphasizes coordinating established production steps, but the update requires earlier and more strategic assessment using digital-first methods before production activity proceeds.
